scope: Editorial fit of the five provisional FactoryPrice-linked concept pieces; no actual garment has been physically inspected, purchased, photographed or approved.

collectionDirection.workingTheme: Black foundations with differentiated surfaces: ribbed cotton, smooth cotton and structured woven tailoring
collectionDirection.publicRepresentationRule: Abstract editorial concept swatches must not be labeled or advertised as purchasable colorways. Require licensed, color-accurate original product photography and supplier-confirmed color variants before creating real offers.

items.whyItBelongs: A ribbed cotton texture balances the smoother bodysuit and tailored trouser without adding a competing statement silhouette.
styleRisks: The candidate is a strapped tank rather than a sleeved autumn layer
Rib rebound, opacity, seam alignment and fit are untested
S/M and L/XL are grouped supplier sizes, not confirmed XS–XL availability
items.commercialGate: The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case yields only €5.38 contribution per placed order before advertising and overhead; do not approve paid acquisition on this assumption.
mustVerify: True garment measurements and size fit
Opaque coverage and rib stretch after washing
Authenticated price, stock and parcel-label cost

items.whyItBelongs: A tucked-in smooth line with the tailored trouser could define a second, dressier look.
styleRisks: Another black sleeveless foundation can look redundant next to the rib top
Closure position, gusset comfort, coverage and hygiene/returns handling are unverified
Only two combined size variants are publicly listed
items.commercialGate: The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case yields €7.31 contribution per placed order before advertising and overhead; require fit evidence, not just nominal unit margin.
mustVerify: Closure, gusset and fit under trousers
Written merchant returns/defect procedure for bodysuits
Authenticated variant allocation and German fulfillment terms

items.whyItBelongs: A straight tailored trouser gives both proposed foundations a coherent full outfit and introduces shape against close-fit tops.
styleRisks: Supplier design is straight-leg with a belt detail, not wide-leg
Narrow published hip measures and inconsistent inseam figures require real fitting across S/M/L/XL
Belt, zipper and drape quality have not been inspected
items.commercialGate: The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case leaves €11.35 per placed order before advertising/overhead, a narrow buffer and not profit.
mustVerify: Waist, hip, inseam and fit on at least two heights
Actual German carrier costs and stock allocation

items.whyItIsHeld: Unverified high gloss may conflict with the restrained editorial look; thin straps require styling context for autumn/winter and the €44 price is fragile in return stress tests.
styleRisks: Acetate/polyester gloss, seams and opacity not physically reviewed
Low supplier-reported quantity of eight per combined size
Concept wine tone does not establish a wine-colored actual SKU
items.commercialGate: The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case leaves €3.25 per placed order before advertising/overhead, below the €10 internal screening buffer.
reopenOnlyIf: Founder approves real finish and seasonality after a physical sample
Written fulfillment and return costs improve the stress case
Live orderable sizes and image rights are verified

items.whyItIsHeld: Supplier calls the garment a summer dress with short sleeves; a 111–114 cm garment length is not midi on every person and does not by itself anchor a November capsule.
styleRisks: Current black cotton listing is a summer item
Loose straight cut and hem position need model-based fit verification
Concept stone tone does not establish a stone-colored actual SKU
items.commercialGate: The hypothetical 20% full-refund, unsellable-goods case leaves €11.35 before advertising/overhead, but healthy illustrative math cannot substitute for seasonal and quality fit.
reopenOnlyIf: Founder confirms it suits the intended season after seeing real samples
Measured hem length and drape support honest customer-facing naming
Material, fulfillment and returns checks pass

founderDecisionsNeeded: Is a black-only sample direction acceptable despite the concept site's abstract chalk, cocoa, wine and stone tones?
Should the first capsule prioritize the three foundations and omit both dresses until a seasonal replacement is proven?
If the rib top and bodysuit look too similar on real samples, which one should carry the basic-layer position?
nonNegotiableLaunchGates: No samples, supplier messages or spend without express founder approval
No Shopify imports, real inventory, checkout or customer-facing claims before documented final fit, material, quantity and legal review
No licensed supplier photograph assumed and no abstract concept swatch treated as a real color
A dated public stock snapshot is not an authenticated allocation or fulfillment guarantee
